plugin_kb.title: Knowledge Base
plugin_kb.description: The AI's source of truth for live chat: upload txt/md documents to be split and embedded automatically; the AI answers only from this content and hands off to a human when nothing matches
plugin_kb.uploadDesc: txt / md / pdf / docx (≤2MB); text is extracted, split and embedded automatically after upload
plugin_kb.uploadHint: Organize content as FAQs or self-contained paragraphs: blank lines become natural chunk boundaries; scanned PDFs (no text layer) cannot be ingested; use the test question box below to verify retrieval after upload
plugin_kb.batchDeleteConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected documents? Their chunks will be removed and the AI will no longer answer from them.
plugin_kb.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its chunks will be removed and the AI will no longer answer from it.

fields.title: Title
fields.thresholdHint: 0~1, higher is stricter: if the best score falls below it, the AI declares "cannot answer" and hands off
fields.topKHint: Max knowledge chunks injected per answer (1~10)
fields.modeHint: Hybrid adds a keyword pass on top of vectors: model numbers, order IDs and exact terms no longer get missed just because the vector looks dissimilar
fields.chunkSizeHint: 100~2000. Larger keeps more context but locates coarser; 400~600 works better for FAQs and short paragraphs
fields.chunkOverlapHint: 0 to half of the chunk size. Overlap keeps a sentence cut at the boundary readable in both chunks
fields.chunkNote: Chunk settings apply to documents ingested from now on. For existing documents, preview and apply a re-chunk from the chunks dialog instead of deleting and re-uploading
fields.systemPromptHint: e.g. "keep answers within three sentences", "use a friendly tone"
fields.systemPromptNote: Style hints only; the hard rule "answer from the material only, admit when unknown" cannot be changed here

plugin_kb.settingsDesc: Tune when the AI admits it doesn't know, and how it sounds
plugin_kb.missingEmbed: Embedding is not enabled: configure an Embedding model under System Settings → Advanced → AI first, or uploads will fail
plugin_kb.missingChat: Chat model is not configured: complete the AI settings under System Settings → Advanced → AI first, or the AI cannot answer
plugin_kb.empty: No documents yet: upload product notes or FAQs so the AI can answer customer questions from them
plugin_kb.askPlaceholder: Ask like a visitor to verify the AI answers from the knowledge base
plugin_kb.askHandoff: No trustworthy match in the knowledge base — live chat would politely explain and hand off to a human, never fabricate
plugin_kb.rechunkPreviewDesc: Current chunk settings would produce {{count}} chunks (currently {{current}}) — the preview is not saved; only applying re-embeds and replaces
plugin_kb.rechunkWarn: These chunks were produced by the current settings and are NOT saved yet; click Apply to re-embed and replace the existing chunks
plugin_kb.rechunkDone: Re-chunked and re-embedded with current settings ({{count}} chunks)
plugin_kb.renameDesc: Change the display title of “{{name}}”. Chunks and vectors are not affected.
plugin_kb.candidatesTitle: Closest candidates below the threshold (for tuning):
plugin_kb.missDesc: Questions visitors asked that the knowledge base could not answer: sorted by how often they come up. Add one answer to turn it into a QA document so the next similar question hits
plugin_kb.missEmpty: No unanswered questions yet: questions the live bot cannot answer collect here automatically
plugin_kb.missResolveDesc: The question and your answer become one QA document, going through the same split and embedding pipeline as an upload
plugin_kb.missAnswerHint: Write how support should answer this question, e.g. The XR-500 comes with a three-year warranty from the purchase date...
plugin_kb.missAnswerNote: Saving creates a new Q/A document and re-embeds it; the rule "answer only from the material" still applies
plugin_kb.missResolveDone: Turned into "{{title}}" — similar questions will now match
plugin_kb.missIgnoreConfirm: Ignore the {{count}} selected questions? They leave the queue and will not reopen even if asked again.
plugin_kb.missReopenDone: Moved back to the answer queue
plugin_kb.missDeleteConfirm: Delete this question? If it was turned into a QA document, that document stays and must be deleted separately from the document list.
